claim_under_test: A causally admissible episodic tensor-residual memory can materially improve strong public partial-observation and non-Markovian PDE forecasters beyond reproduced frontier models without using protected targets or materially increasing non-query error.

candidate.name: ITFM-R
candidate.form: backbone prediction plus validation-calibrated retrieved residual tensor
candidate.key: detached backbone latent context plus observation mask and lead-time encoding
candidate.value: detached observation-space residual tensor available only after the target becomes observable
candidate.retrieval: same-trajectory, strictly past, minimum-age, top-k cosine retrieval
candidate.calibration: validation-only scalar or monotone gate; clipped to a preregistered safe range
candidate.test_updates: past observed transitions may be appended online; test targets may never tune parameters, thresholds, keys, or calibration

stages.name: source_data_license_and_compute_admission
stages.gate: exact upstream commits, dataset checksums, licenses, split manifests, accelerator identity, wall-clock budget, memory budget, and carbon/cost receipt are recorded

stages.name: exact_frontier_reproduction
stages.gate: official LANO and HS-FNO results reproduce within declared tolerance before ITFM-R is evaluated

stages.name: oracle_memory_gap_triage
stages.gate: validation-only past-residual oracle improves the matching frontier backbone by at least 10% on at least two POBench-PDE datasets or three HS-FNO families

stages.name: development_and_ablation
stages.gate: train and validation only; fixed budgets; no protected-test inspection; all memory interventions retained

stages.name: frozen_multiseed_test
stages.gate: all declared seeds, cells, failures, latency, memory, parameter, and energy metrics are retained

stages.name: independent_reproduction
stages.gate: fresh environment and operator reproduce hashes, splits, primary metrics, and claim decision

fairness.optimization: equal train examples, early-stopping information, tuning trials, and wall-clock envelope within each backbone class
fairness.capacity: report backbone, adapter, and memory-bank parameters/bytes separately; include parameter-matched learned residual control
fairness.compute: report training and inference wall time, peak accelerator memory, throughput, and energy where available
fairness.data: official trajectory-level splits only; no family or trajectory crosses a split
fairness.failures: all seeds, cells, OOMs, divergence, and unavailable baselines remain in the manifest

allowed_before_freeze: upstream reproduction on official validation settings
forbidden_before_final_run: choosing datasets or cells from candidate test outcomes
changing retrieval thresholds from candidate test outcomes

claim_policy.broad_sota_allowed_only_if: both primary and secondary material gates pass plus independent reproduction
claim_policy.track_specific_sota_allowed_only_if: the corresponding complete material gate passes plus independent reproduction
claim_policy.otherwise: report bounded positive, mixed, negative, invalid, or resource-blocked outcome exactly
